Container.Name: nowplaying
Container.Overview: Full-screen now-playing display and ambient visualizer for Spotify and Plex. Shows rich metadata, an up-next queue, synced lyrics and playback controls, including direct Chromecast control for Plex cast sessions. Credentials are entered in the web UI and stored in /config.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, Spotify login and history. Tailscale state is also kept here (/config/.tailscale_state).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The https:// address used to open the app; only needed if the Spotify redirect URI shown in Settings is wrong.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional. Overrides the value set in the web UI, e.g. http://192.168.1.69:32400

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Optional. Overrides the value set in the web UI.

Config.Name: Admin PIN
Config.Description: Optional PIN required to open Settings.
